# API Contract, Ledger & Sync Checklist: Transactions Ledger

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements behind the B6 API surface frozen for the C6 client: transfer shape, error codes, precedence, restore, concurrency and the ledger obligations inherited from specs 008, 010 and 011.
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [transactions.yaml](../../../docs/openapi/paths/transactions.yaml)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. Depth: standard; audience: PR reviewer. The owner delegated the review to the agent running the design phases, which evaluated each item and fixed the spec where an item failed (resolution log below).
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Is every member of the Transaction resource listed with its type and nullability? [Completeness, Spec §5]
- [x] CHK002 - Is the wire representation of a transfer (one record vs two linked records) stated explicitly? [Completeness, Spec §5, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK003 - Is the role needed on each side of a transfer stated, including the response for a viewer, a non-member and an unknown destination? [Completeness, Spec §5, §6]
- [x] CHK004 - Are stable codes defined for a currency change after the first transaction and for a cross-currency transfer? [Completeness, Spec §5]
- [x] CHK005 - Is restore of a tombstoned transaction decided, with its request shape and authorization? [Completeness, Spec FR-014]
- [x] CHK006 - Are the requirements for `created_by` after another member's edit, delete or restore stated? [Completeness, Spec FR-002]
- [x] CHK007 - Is the event behaviour for transactions tombstoned by a wallet deletion defined? [Gap → Spec FR-027]
- [x] CHK008 - Does every spec §4 invariant name a test, including wallet deletion and the default-currency lock? [Traceability, Spec §4]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK009 - Is "identical write" defined precisely enough to decide a PATCH replay? [Clarity, Spec FR-012]
- [x] CHK010 - Is the direction of money in a transfer unambiguous (`wallet_id` source, `counter_wallet_id` destination)? [Clarity, Spec FR-006]
- [x] CHK011 - Are text length limits stated in characters rather than bytes? [Clarity, Spec FR-002]
- [x] CHK012 - Is the `search` matching rule (literal, case-insensitive, which fields) specified? [Clarity, Spec FR-017]
- [x] CHK013 - Is the `in` operator bounded for `category_id`? [Clarity, Spec FR-017]
- [x] CHK014 - Is the performance target measurable (page size, percentile, environment)? [Measurability, Spec SC-007]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK015 - Are the PATCH-able members consistent between FR-012, §5 and the path file (no `kind`, `currency`, `counter_wallet_id`)? [Consistency, Spec FR-012, §5]
- [x] CHK016 - Is the precedence in §6 consistent with the path file's PUT outcome list? [Consistency, Spec §6]
- [x] CHK017 - Do the immutability rules for `kind` and `counter_wallet_id` agree across FR-004, Edge Cases, §5 and ADR-0015? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK018 - Does "in use" (FR-021) count the same records as the reference withdrawal rule (FR-022) and the currency lock (FR-019)? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK019 - Are event names consistent with the constitution's context table? [Consistency, Spec §7]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK020 - Are requirements defined for an edit of a tombstone (conflict, not restore) and a restore of a live record (200 unchanged)? [Coverage, Spec §6]
- [x] CHK021 - Is a transfer whose other wallet was deleted covered for read, edit, delete and restore? [Coverage, Spec FR-015]
- [x] CHK022 - Are archived wallets and archived categories addressed? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK023 - Is another member's category on an edited transaction addressed? [Coverage, Spec FR-005, US3 S7]
- [x] CHK024 - Is the delete-versus-first-use race on a category addressed? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK025 - Is a transaction id reused under another wallet or another entity type addressed? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases, P-06]
- [x] CHK026 - Is concurrency between two writers of the same transfer from its two wallets addressed? [Coverage, Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional & Dependencies

- [x] CHK027 - Are logging restrictions for amounts and text stated? [Security, Spec FR-026]
- [x] CHK028 - Is the dependency on catalogue parity for the new code (enum and strings in one change) documented? [Dependency, Plan A-18]
- [x] CHK029 - Is the feed-row shape B14 consumes referenced rather than re-invented? [Dependency, Spec §5, ADR-0015]

### Resolution log

| Item | Finding | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| CHK006 | `created_by` stability after edits unstated | FR-002: never changes |
| CHK007 | Wallet-deletion cascade vs `TransactionVoided` undefined | FR-027: cascade announces nothing; consumers use `WalletDeleted`; replays announce nothing |
| CHK008 | Wallet deletion and default-currency lock had no invariant row | §4 gains two rows; §8 gains the wallet-deletion row |
| CHK009 | "Identical" undefined for PATCH | FR-012: every member sent equals the stored value; nothing moves |
| CHK011 | Unit of length unstated | FR-002: Unicode characters |
| CHK013 | `in` list unbounded | FR-017 and the path file: at most 50 values |
| CHK014 | "Reference environment" vague | SC-007: page of 50, dev stack, debugging off |
| CHK015, CHK017 | A transfer's destination was editable in the first draft | Made immutable (FR-004, ADR-0015 rule 3a); PATCH list aligned |
